post.title: Cell-Based Architectures: Designing Fault Isolation Boundaries for Million-User Apps
post.subtitle: Design and implement cell-based routing using Spring Cloud Gateway to limit system blast radius.
post.brief: As microservice architectures scale, a single outage in a core service can cascade across the entire system. Cell-Based Architecture mitigates this by partitioning the entire system into small, self-contained, independent units called cells. This guide outlines their routing mechanics and provides a custom Spring Cloud Gateway filter for cell-based traffic distribution.
